title: Witness Ed tests reverse-engineered vehicles
summary: UAPGerb tells of Witness Ed tests reverse-engineered vehicles, about 1998-2006 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he said in 2000 1998 to 2002 this guy Ed um was briefed into programs that while he was at Nellis under the 98th Range Wing

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels about a witness codenamed Ed. According to UAPGerb, from about 1998 to 2002 Ed was briefed into secret programs while serving at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, under the 98th Range Wing, the unit that runs the military ranges there, where vehicles built by copying unknown technology were said to be tested. If true, it would mean the US has been flying such craft for decades.
